title: Stripe payments
description: Checkout Session creation with variants, inventory, and discount codes; webhook marks orders paid and decrements stock.

markers.block:
export { createCheckoutSession } from './callable/createCheckoutSession';
export { stripeWebhook } from './http/stripeWebhook';

notes: Production: firebase functions:secrets:set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
Add `stripe` to functions/package.json dependencies (see functions notes in this module).
Prefer Checkout Sessions for one-time payments; omit payment_method_types for dynamic payment methods.
Never trust client totals — createCheckoutSession reloads prices from Firestore.
